desc.en: Live in a university res on or near campus
desc.zu: Uhlala e-res yenyuvesi ekhampasi noma eduze

desc.en: Rent from a private landlord in {area}
At home or with relatives, travelling to campus by taxi, bus or train
desc.zu: Ekhaya noma nezihlobo, uya ekhampasi ngetekisi, ibhasi noma isitimela

desc.en: Government bursary with a living allowance

rentNote.en: Rent is paid by NSFAS directly to an accredited provider. Check that your place is accredited.
rentNote.zu: Irenti ikhokhwa yi-NSFAS ngqo kumhlinzeki ogunyaziwe. Qinisekisa ukuthi indawo yakho igunyaziwe.

rentNote.en: Check your contract to see whether rent is paid directly or comes out of your stipend.
rentNote.zu: Bheka inkontileka yakho ukuthi irenti ikhokhwa ngqo noma iphuma emalini yakho.

desc.en: Family covers fees and sends money
desc.zu: Umndeni ukhokha izimali futhi uthumela imali

rentNote.en: Agree with your family who pays rent, and on which date, before term starts.
rentNote.zu: Vumelanani nomndeni ukuthi ubani okhokha irenti, nangaluphi usuku, ngaphambi kokuqala kwetemu.

rentNote.en: Put rent first in your budget. It is the bill that cannot wait.
rentNote.zu: Faka irenti kuqala ebhajethini yakho. Yisikweletu esingakwazi ukulinda.

desc.en: Your first time living in a city
Matric last year or this year
desc.zu: I-matric ngonyaka odlule noma kulo nyaka

desc.en: You work, care for someone or support a household
desc.zu: Uyasebenza, unakekela othile noma usekela umndeni

text.en: A friend is ordering takeaways. Add yours for {amount}?
text.zu: Umngane uoda ukudla okuthathwayo. Ufaka okwakho ngo-{amount}?

text.en: New sneakers are on sale for {amount}. Buy them?
text.zu: Izicathulo ezintsha zidayiswa ngo-{amount}. Uyazithenga?

text.en: Sign up for a streaming subscription at {amount} a month?
text.zu: Ubhalisela ukubuka okubhaliselwayo ngo-{amount} ngenyanga?

text.en: Your data's low. Buy a social bundle for {amount}?
text.zu: Idatha yakho iphansi. Uthenga i-bundle yezokuxhumana ngo-{amount}?

text.en: Tickets for a campus concert: {amount}. Go?
text.zu: Amathikithi ekhonsathi yasekhampasi: u-{amount}. Uyahamba?

text.en: End of a long week. Takeaways for {amount}?
text.zu: Ukuphela kwesonto elide. Ukudla okuthathwayo ngo-{amount}?

body.en: You passed both key modules. You're on track for second year, and you know where help is if things change.
body.zu: Uphase zombili izifundo ezibalulekile. Usendleleni eya onyakeni wesibili, futhi uyazi ukuthi usizo lukuphi uma izinto zishintsha.

body.en: One key module is below the pass mark. There's still time: exams carry a lot of weight, and coaches and advisors can help you plan a recovery.
body.zu: Isifundo esisodwa esibalulekile singaphansi kwamamaki okuphasa. Sisekhona isikhathi: izivivinyo zokugcina zinesisindo esikhulu, futhi abaqeqeshi nabeluleki bangakusiza uhlele ukubuyisela.

title.en: A tough start, and a chance to change it

body.en: Both key modules are below the pass mark. In real life this is the moment to act, not quit: see an advisor this week. Try playing again with different choices to see what changes.
body.zu: Zombili izifundo ezibalulekile zingaphansi kwamamaki okuphasa. Empilweni yangempela lesi yisikhathi sokuthatha isinyathelo, hhayi ukuyeka: bona umeluleki kuleli sonto. Zama ukudlala futhi ngezinqumo ezahlukene ubone ukuthi yini eshintshayo.

nsfas.en: NSFAS has required first-years to pass a minimum share of their registered credits (historically at least half) to stay funded. Failing key modules can cost you your funding. Confirm the current rule with NSFAS.
nsfas.zu: I-NSFAS ibidinga ukuthi abafundi bonyaka wokuqala baphase ingxenye ethile yamakhredithi ababhalisele wona (ngokomlando okungenani ingxenye) ukuze baqhubeke bexhaswa. Ukwehluleka ezifundweni ezibalulekile kungakulahlekisela ngomxhaso. Qinisekisa umthetho wamanje ne-NSFAS.

bursary.en: Most bursaries require you to pass a minimum of your modules or keep an average. Check your contract now, not after exams.
bursary.zu: Iningi lemixhaso lidinga ukuthi uphase inani elithile lezifundo noma ugcine isilinganiso. Hlola inkontileka yakho manje, hhayi emva kwezivivinyo.

family.en: Paying for repeated modules is expensive for a family. Passing key modules first time saves real money.
family.zu: Ukukhokhela izifundo eziphindwayo kubiza kakhulu emndenini. Ukuphasa izifundo ezibalulekile okokuqala konga imali yangempela.

self.en: Repeating modules costs you fees and time. Passing key modules first time protects your loan and savings.
self.zu: Ukuphinda izifundo kukubiza imali nesikhathi. Ukuphasa izifundo ezibalulekile okokuqala kuvikela imalimboleko nemali yakho olondoloze.

all.en: At {short}, failing key first-year modules like {mod1} and {mod2} can block progression to second-year modules that build on them.
all.zu: E-{short}, ukwehluleka ezifundweni ezibalulekile zonyaka wokuqala njenge-{mod1} ne-{mod2} kungavimba ukuqhubekela ezifundweni zonyaka wesibili ezakhela phezu kwazo.

offers.en: Help choosing the right modules, changing your curriculum, and making a plan if you fall behind.
offers.zu: Usizo ekukhetheni izifundo ezifanele, ekushintsheni uhlelo lwakho lwezifundo, nasekwenzeni uhlelo uma usala emuva.

reach.en: Ask at your faculty's student administration office.
reach.zu: Buza ehhovisi labafundi lefakhalthi yakho.

offers.en: A senior student mentor who helps you settle in, find your way around and cope with the first semester.
offers.zu: Umeluleki ongumfundi omdala okusiza ukuthi uzinze, uthole indlela futhi ubhekane nesemesta yokuqala.

reach.en: Sign up at the start of the year through your faculty or Student Affairs.
reach.zu: Bhalisa ekuqaleni konyaka ngefakhalthi yakho noma ngoMnyango Wezindaba Zabafundi.

offers.en: Food parcels, vouchers or meals for students who are struggling to afford food.
offers.zu: Amaphasela okudla, amavawusha noma ukudla kwabafundi abangakwazi ukuthenga ukudla.

reach.en: Ask Student Affairs or the SRC. Go early: you don't need to wait until you have nothing left.
reach.zu: Buza kuMnyango Wezindaba Zabafundi noma i-SRC. Hamba kusenesikhathi: akudingeki ulinde kuze kungabi nalutho.

tip.en: Go before you run out: the programme is there to be used, and nobody asks why you need it.
tip.zu: Hamba ngaphambi kokuthi uphelelwe: uhlelo lukhona ukuze lusetshenziswe, futhi akekho obuza ukuthi kungani uludinga.

offers.en: The financial aid office and the SRC help follow up on late or missing allowances, appeals and other funding problems.
offers.zu: Ihhovisi losizo lwezimali ne-SRC basiza ukulandelela imali ephuzile noma engekho, izikhalazo nezinye izinkinga zomxhaso.

reach.en: Visit the financial aid office or the SRC on campus. If you are on NSFAS, check your status on the myNSFAS portal and call the NSFAS contact centre.
reach.zu: Vakashela ihhovisi losizo lwezimali noma i-SRC ekhampasi. Uma use-NSFAS, hlola isimo sakho kuphothali ye-myNSFAS futhi ushayele isikhungo sokuxhumana se-NSFAS.

preview.en: The official NSFAS website. Apply for funding, check your status on myNSFAS, and read the funding rules. Applying is free.
preview.zu: Iwebhusayithi esemthethweni ye-NSFAS. Faka isicelo soxhaso, uhlole isimo sakho ku-myNSFAS, futhi ufunde imithetho yoxhaso. Ukufaka isicelo kumahhala.

name.en: Check a room before you pay

offers.en: Use the list of accredited off-campus accommodation. View the room in person, get a written lease, and confirm an agent's registration with the PPRA. Search the photos online, and never pay a deposit under pressure.
offers.zu: Sebenzisa uhlu lwezindawo zokuhlala ezigunyaziwe ngaphandle kwekhampasi. Bona ikamelo ngamehlo, thola inkontileka ebhaliwe, futhi uqinisekise ukubhaliswa kwe-ejenti ne-PPRA. Sesha izithombe ku-inthanethi, futhi ungalokothi ukhokhe idiphozithi ngaphansi kwengcindezi.

reach.en: Ask the residence and accommodation office for the accredited list, or find it on the accommodation page of the official website. If you are on NSFAS, your room must be NSFAS-accredited too.
reach.zu: Cela uhlu olugunyaziwe ehhovisi lezindawo zokuhlala, noma uluthole ekhasini lezindawo zokuhlala kuwebhusayithi esemthethweni. Uma use-NSFAS, ikamelo lakho kufanele ligunyazwe yi-NSFAS nalo.

preview.en: The official NSFAS website. Apply for funding, check your status on myNSFAS, and read the funding rules. Applying is free.
preview.zu: Iwebhusayithi esemthethweni ye-NSFAS. Faka isicelo soxhaso, uhlole isimo sakho ku-myNSFAS, futhi ufunde imithetho yoxhaso. Ukufaka isicelo kumahhala.

offers.en: Every residence has a house committee and peer mentors who can help with noise, roommates, study space and settling in.
offers.zu: Yonke i-res inekomidi lendlu nabeluleki bontanga abangasiza ngomsindo, abahlala nawe, indawo yokufunda nokuzinza.

reach.en: Ask your floor representative or the house committee in your res.
reach.zu: Buza ummeleli wefulethi lakho noma ikomidi lendlu e-res yakho.

offers.en: Study spaces that stay open after lectures, and student communities for those who don't live on campus.
offers.zu: Izindawo zokufunda ezihlala zivulekile emva kwezifundo, nemiphakathi yabafundi abangahlali ekhampasi.

reach.en: Ask Student Affairs. If you're on NSFAS, check your transport allowance on myNSFAS.
reach.zu: Buza kuMnyango Wezindaba Zabafundi. Uma use-NSFAS, hlola imali yakho yokugibela ku-myNSFAS.

offers.en: Prescribed textbooks are kept on short-loan, so you can use them without buying.
offers.zu: Izincwadi ezimisiwe zigcinwa ukuze zibolekwe okwesikhashana, ukuze uzisebenzise ngaphandle kokuzithenga.

reach.en: Ask at the library help desk, or search the library catalogue.
reach.zu: Buza edeskini losizo lomtapo wolwazi, noma useshe ikhathalogi.

offers.en: There's no single right answer. Decide upfront what share of your money you can send each month, put it in your budget, and tell home when your money arrives so they can plan too.
offers.zu: Ayikho impendulo eyodwa efanele. Nquma kusenesikhathi ukuthi ingakanani ingxenye yemali yakho ongayithumela nyanga zonke, uyifake ebhajethini yakho, futhi utshele ekhaya uma imali yakho ifika ukuze nabo bahlele.

reach.en: Your survival plan includes a line for family support. Share it with home.
reach.zu: Uhlelo lwakho lokusinda lunomugqa wosizo lomndeni. Wabelane nekhaya.

offers.en: One-on-one help to plan your study time, prepare for tests and manage clashing deadlines.
offers.zu: Usizo lomuntu ngamunye lokuhlela isikhathi sakho sokufunda, ukulungiselela izivivinyo nokuphatha izinsuku zokuhambisa ezingqubuzanayo.

reach.en: Ask your faculty or the academic development office.
reach.zu: Buza efakhalthini yakho noma ehhovisi lokuthuthukiswa kwezemfundo.

offers.en: Free, confidential counselling, in person or online. You don't need to be in crisis to go.
offers.zu: Ukwelulekwa kwamahhala, okuyimfihlo, ngomuntu noma ku-inthanethi. Akudingeki ube senkingeni enkulu ukuze uye.

reach.en: Book through Student Affairs. If you're in crisis, call a free line any time:
reach.zu: Bhukha ngoMnyango Wezindaba Zabafundi. Uma usenkingeni, shayela inombolo yamahhala noma nini:

name.zu: Kungani izifundo ezibalulekile zonyaka wokuqala zibalulekile

offers.en: Key modules unlock second-year modules, and funders check how many credits you pass.
offers.zu: Izifundo ezibalulekile zivula izifundo zonyaka wesibili, futhi abaxhasi bahlola ukuthi uphase amakhredithi amangaki.

reach.en: If any module is below 50% after tests, see a faculty advisor the same week.
reach.zu: Uma noma yisiphi isifundo singaphansi kuka-50% emva kwezivivinyo, bona umeluleki wefakhalthi ngalelo sonto.

offers.en: Teams, cultural, faith, academic and hobby societies: a cheap way to meet people and feel at home.
offers.zu: Amaqembu, izinhlangano zamasiko, zokholo, zemfundo nezokuzilibazisa: indlela eshibhile yokuhlangana nabantu nokuzizwa usekhaya.

reach.en: Look out for Societies Day at the start of the year, or ask the SRC and Student Affairs.
reach.zu: Bheka uSuku Lwezinhlangano ekuqaleni konyaka, noma ubuze i-SRC noMnyango Wezindaba Zabafundi.

name.en: How monthly debit orders add up
name.zu: Indlela ama-debit order anyanga zonke anqwabelana ngayo

offers.en: Gym contracts, phone contracts and subscriptions all leave your account automatically. Add up every debit order before signing, and check the cancellation terms.
offers.zu: Izivumelwano zejimu, zocingo nokubhaliselwe konke kuphuma ku-akhawunti yakho ngokuzenzakalela. Hlanganisa wonke ama-debit order ngaphambi kokusayina, futhi uhlole imigomo yokukhansela.

reach.en: Your survival plan's budget shows what's left after fixed costs.
reach.zu: Ibhajethi yohlelo lwakho lokusinda ikhombisa okusalayo emva kwezindleko ezingaguquki.

name.en: Computer labs, Wi-Fi and device support

offers.en: Open computer labs, library computers and free campus Wi-Fi, plus laptop loans and device support for students who need them.
offers.zu: Amagumbi amakhompyutha avulekile, amakhompyutha omtapo ne-Wi-Fi yamahhala yasekhampasi, kanye nokubolekwa kwama-laptop nosizo lwamadivayisi kubafundi abakudingayo.

reach.en: Ask the library or Student Affairs which labs open late, and how to apply for a laptop loan.
reach.zu: Buza emtapweni noma kuMnyango Wezindaba Zabafundi ukuthi yimaphi amagumbi avula kuze kube sebusuku, nokuthi usifaka kanjani isicelo sokubolekwa i-laptop.

offers.en: Campus tours, welcome events and first-year sessions on where to find help.
offers.zu: Uhambo lwekhampasi, imicimbi yokwamukela namaseshini onyaka wokuqala okuthi ungalutholaphi usizo.

reach.en: Check your welcome pack or ask at the student centre in your first week.
reach.zu: Hlola iphakethe lakho lokwamukela noma ubuze esikhungweni sabafundi ngesonto lakho lokuqala.

offers.en: Residence waiting lists, temporary placements and the list of accredited private accommodation.
offers.zu: Uhlu lokulinda lwe-res, izindawo zesikhashana nohlu lwezindawo ezizimele ezigunyaziwe.

reach.en: Visit or email the residence office before paying anyone for a room.
reach.zu: Vakashela noma uthumele i-imeyili ehhovisi lezindawo zokuhlala ngaphambi kokukhokhela umuntu ikamelo.

offers.en: Payment arrangements, fee statements, and information on programmes that help with historic student debt.
offers.zu: Izivumelwano zokukhokha, izitatimende zezimali, nolwazi ngezinhlelo ezisiza ngezikweletu ezindala zabafundi.

reach.en: Ask at the student service centre. Do it before debt blocks registration or your certificate.
reach.zu: Buza esikhungweni sezinsizakalo zabafundi. Kwenze ngaphambi kokuthi isikweletu sivimbe ukubhalisa noma isitifiketi sakho.

offers.en: CV help, mock interviews, career fairs where employers come to campus, vacation work and graduate programme advice, and help if you're unsure about your course.
offers.zu: Usizo nge-CV, izingxoxo zokuzilolonga, imibukiso yemisebenzi lapho abaqashi beza ekhampasi, umsebenzi wamaholide nezeluleko zezinhlelo zabaphothule, nosizo uma ungaqiniseki ngesifundo sakho.

reach.en: Book through Student Affairs, from first year onwards.
reach.zu: Bhukha ngoMnyango Wezindaba Zabafundi, kusukela onyakeni wokuqala.

offers.en: Your lecturers set aside hours every week for students. Few students use them, and they make a real difference.
offers.zu: Abafundisi bakho babekela abafundi amahora masonto onke. Bambalwa abafundi abawasebenzisayo, futhi enza umehluko wangempela.

reach.en: Check the module guide or the course page for times.
reach.zu: Hlola umhlahlandlela wesifundo noma ikhasi lesifundo ukuthola izikhathi.

offers.en: Free or low-cost, confidential health care: illness, contraception, pregnancy tests and sexual health.
offers.zu: Ukunakekelwa kwezempilo kwamahhala noma kwentengo ephansi, okuyimfihlo: ukugula, izivikelo zokukhulelwa, ukuhlolwa kokukhulelwa nempilo yezocansi.

reach.en: Walk in or book at the campus clinic.
reach.zu: Ngena noma ubhukhe emtholampilo wasekhampasi.

name.zu: Inombolo yosizo ye-Higher Health yamahora angu-24

offers.en: Free, confidential support for students, 24 hours a day, including mental health and gender-based violence.
offers.zu: Usizo lwamahhala, oluyimfihlo lwabafundi, amahora angu-24 ngosuku, kuhlanganise impilo yengqondo nodlame olusekelwe ebulilini.

reach.en: Call any time:
reach.zu: Shayela noma nini:

offers.en: Campus security, marked safe walking routes (green routes), and escorts or shuttles between campus and residences after dark.
offers.zu: Ezokuphepha ekhampasi, izindlela zokuhamba eziphephile ezimakiwe (ama-green route), nokuphelezelwa noma ama-shuttle phakathi kwekhampasi nezindawo zokuhlala ebusuku.

reach.en: Save campus security's emergency number on your first day. At orientation, ask where the safe routes run and how to ask security to walk with you.
reach.zu: Londoloza inombolo yezimo eziphuthumayo yezokuphepha ngosuku lwakho lokuqala. Ngesikhathi sokwethulwa, buza ukuthi izindlela eziphephile zikuphi nokuthi ucela kanjani ukuphelezelwa ngabezokuphepha.

offers.en: Support and a confidential way to report discrimination, harassment or unfair treatment.
offers.zu: Usizo nendlela eyimfihlo yokubika ukucwasa, ukuhlukunyezwa noma ukuphathwa ngokungalungile.

reach.en: Ask Student Affairs or the SRC to put you in touch.
reach.zu: Cela uMnyango Wezindaba Zabafundi noma i-SRC ukuthi bakuxhumanise nalo.

offers.en: Help with settling in, study permits and peer groups for students from other countries.
offers.zu: Usizo lokuzinza, izimvume zokufunda namaqembu ontanga abafundi abavela kwamanye amazwe.

reach.en: Ask at the student centre or the international office.
reach.zu: Buza esikhungweni sabafundi noma ehhovisi lamazwe ngamazwe.

offers.en: Free workshops and one-on-one sessions on time management, academic writing, study methods and exam preparation, run by the academic development unit and the writing centre.
offers.zu: Amasifundisane amahhala namaseshini omuntu ngamunye okuphatha isikhathi, ukubhala kwezemfundo, izindlela zokufunda nokulungiselela izivivinyo, aqhutshwa uphiko lokuthuthukiswa kwezemfundo nesikhungo sokubhala.

reach.en: Look for the workshop calendar on the official website or the student portal, or ask at the library.
reach.zu: Bheka ikhalenda lamasifundisane kuwebhusayithi esemthethweni noma kuphothali yabafundi, noma ubuze emtapweni.

tip.en: Workshops are not only for students who are failing. Senior students use them to get faster and better.
tip.zu: Amasifundisane awawona awabafundi abahlulekayo kuphela. Abafundi abadala bawasebenzisa ukuze basheshe futhi benze kangcono.

offers.en: Applications are made on each university's own official website, and they open and close on different dates. Fill it in yourself, and keep your reference number and every confirmation email.
offers.zu: Izicelo zenziwa kuwebhusayithi esemthethweni yenyuvesi ngayinye, futhi zivulwa zivalwe ngezinsuku ezahlukene. Zigcwalisele wena, futhi ugcine inombolo yakho yereferensi nawo wonke ama-imeyili okuqinisekisa.

reach.en: Search for the university's official website and look for "Apply" or "Admissions". If you are unsure a site is real, ask your school or phone the university.
reach.zu: Sesha iwebhusayithi esemthethweni yenyuvesi bese ubheka "Apply" noma "Admissions". Uma ungaqiniseki ukuthi isayithi ingeyangempela, buza esikoleni sakho noma ushayele inyuvesi.

offers.en: NSFAS applications are free and are made only on the official NSFAS website. Bursaries come from universities, companies, foundations and government departments, and each has its own requirements and closing date.
offers.zu: Izicelo ze-NSFAS zimahhala futhi zenziwa kuphela kuwebhusayithi esemthethweni ye-NSFAS. Imifundaze ivela emanyuvesi, ezinkampanini, ezisekelweni naseminyangweni kahulumeni, futhi ngamunye unezidingo zawo nosuku lokuvala.

reach.en: Read the requirements on the funder's own official page, carefully and to the end, before you apply. Ask your school's Life Orientation teacher and the university's financial aid page which bursaries fit your course.
reach.zu: Funda izidingo ekhasini elisemthethweni lomxhasi uqobo, ngokucophelela kuze kube sekugcineni, ngaphambi kokufaka isicelo. Buza uthisha wakho we-Life Orientation nekhasi losizo lwezimali lenyuvesi ukuthi yimiphi imifundaze efanele isifundo sakho.

preview.en: The official NSFAS website. Apply for funding, check your status on myNSFAS, and read the funding rules. Applying is free.
preview.zu: Iwebhusayithi esemthethweni ye-NSFAS. Faka isicelo soxhaso, uhlole isimo sakho ku-myNSFAS, futhi ufunde imithetho yoxhaso. Ukufaka isicelo kumahhala.

offers.en: Nobody can sell you a place or guaranteed funding. Don't let a stranger apply for you, and never share your ID number, passwords or one-time PINs. Application and NSFAS help is free at your school and at the university.
offers.zu: Akekho ongakuthengisela indawo noma uxhaso oluqinisekisiwe. Ungavumeli umuntu ongamazi akufakele isicelo, futhi ungalokothi wabelane ngenombolo yakho kamazisi, amaphasiwedi noma ama-PIN esikhashana. Usizo lwezicelo nolwe-NSFAS lumahhala esikoleni sakho nasenyuvesi.

reach.en: Use only official websites, pay fees only into the institution's own account, and ask your school if anything feels rushed or secret.
reach.zu: Sebenzisa amawebhusayithi asemthethweni kuphela, khokha izimali ku-akhawunti yesikhungo uqobo kuphela, futhi ubuze esikoleni sakho uma kukhona okuzwakala kuphuthunyiswa noma kuyimfihlo.

tip.en: Pressure is the warning sign: "pay today", "only two places left", "send me your password".
tip.zu: Ingcindezi iyisibonakaliso sexwayiso: "khokha namuhla", "kusele izindawo ezimbili kuphela", "ngithumelele iphasiwedi yakho".

offers.en: Residences provide a bed, a desk and a cupboard, but not bedding, a lock, crockery or cleaning things. Private rooms vary: some are furnished and some are empty.
offers.zu: Izindawo zokuhlala zinikeza umbhede, ideski nekhabethe, kodwa hhayi izingubo zokulala, ingidi, izitsha noma izinto zokuhlanza. Amakamelo azimele ayahluka: amanye anefenisha kanti amanye awanalutho.

reach.en: Ask the residence office, or your landlord, for the list of what is provided and what is not allowed: residences ban some appliances. Res WhatsApp groups sell second-hand basics cheaply.
reach.zu: Cela uhlu ehhovisi lezindawo zokuhlala, noma kumnikazi wendlu, lwalokho okunikezwayo nokungavunyelwe: izindawo zokuhlala zenqabela ezinye izinto zikagesi. Amaqembu e-WhatsApp e-res athengisa izinto ezisetshenzisiwe ngentengo ephansi.

offers.en: Your student card opens the library, computer labs, residences and test venues, so get it in your first days. Queues are longest in registration week.
offers.zu: Ikhadi lakho lomfundi livula umtapo, amagumbi amakhompyutha, izindawo zokuhlala nezindawo zezivivinyo, ngakho lithole ezinsukwini zakho zokuqala. Imigqa mide kakhulu ngesonto lokubhalisa.

reach.en: Bring your ID and proof of registration. The official website shows where the card office is, and early mornings are quieter.
reach.zu: Letha umazisi wakho nobufakazi bokubhalisa. Iwebhusayithi esemthethweni ikhombisa ukuthi ihhovisi lamakhadi likuphi, futhi ekuseni kuthule kakhulu.

offers.en: A supplementary exam is a second chance to write a module you narrowly failed. The result codes on your portal say whether you passed, failed or were admitted to one.
offers.zu: Isivivinyo esengeziwe yithuba lesibili lokubhala isifundo osehluleke kancane kuso. Amakhodi emiphumela ku-portal yakho asho ukuthi uphasile, wehlulekile noma uvunyelwe ukubhala esengeziwe.

reach.en: Check your results on the student portal, then ask your faculty office for the date and how to confirm that you will write. The deadlines are short.
reach.zu: Hlola imiphumela yakho ku-portal yabafundi, bese ubuza ihhovisi lefakhalthi yakho usuku nokuthi uqinisekisa kanjani ukuthi uzobhala. Izinsuku zokuvala zimfushane.

tip.en: A supp is a second opportunity, not a verdict on you. Ask to see your script at a perusal, then practise past papers on what you got wrong.
tip.zu: Isivivinyo esengeziwe yithuba lesibili, akusona isahlulelo ngawe. Cela ukubona iphepha lakho ku-perusal, bese uzilolonga ngamaphepha adlule kulokho okuphuthile.

text.en: Keep a buffer: set aside two weeks of food money from your first payment.
text.zu: Gcina imali eyisiphephelo: beka eceleni imali yokudla yamasonto amabili enkokhelweni yakho yokuqala.

text.en: Check your status on myNSFAS and save the NSFAS number: 08000 67327.
text.zu: Hlola isimo sakho ku-myNSFAS futhi ulondoloze inombolo ye-NSFAS: 08000 67327.

text.en: Save your bursary officer's email and number, and ask them for the payment dates.
text.zu: Londoloza i-imeyili nenombolo yesikhulu somxhaso wakho, futhi ubacele izinsuku zokukhokha.

text.en: Agree the exact payment date with whoever sends your money, and what happens if it's late.
text.zu: Vumelanani ngosuku oluqondile lokukhokha nalowo othumela imali yakho, nokuthi kuzokwenzekani uma yephuza.

text.en: Go to campus food support early, before food runs out, not after.
text.zu: Yiya osizweni lokudla lwasekhampasi kusenesikhathi, ngaphambi kokuthi ukudla kuphele, hhayi emva kwalokho.

text.en: Ask the SRC or financial aid office to follow up if your allowance is more than a week late.
text.zu: Cela i-SRC noma ihhovisi lezezimali lilandelele uma imali yakho yephuze ngaphezu kwesonto.

text.en: Tell your landlord early, in writing, if rent will be late.
text.zu: Tshela umnikazi wendlu kusenesikhathi, ngokubhala, uma irenti izophuza.

text.en: If you borrow, write down who and how much, and repay on payday.
text.zu: Uma uboleka, bhala phansi ukuthi ubani nokuthi malini, bese ubuyisela ngosuku lokuholela.

text.en: Don't skip meals to stretch money. Hunger costs you marks.
text.zu: Ungeqi ukudla ukuze welule imali. Indlala ikulahlekisela ngamamaki.

what.en: Register, then confirm your modules with a faculty advisor
what.zu: Bhalisa, bese uqinisekisa izifundo zakho nomeluleki wefakhalthi

what.en: Last chance to add or change modules. Sign up for first-year mentorship.
what.zu: Ithuba lokugcina lokwengeza noma ukushintsha izifundo. Bhalisela ukwelulekwa konyaka wokuqala.

what.en: First allowance. It may be late, so have your buffer and playbook ready.
what.zu: Imali yokuqala. Ingase yephuze, ngakho lungisa imali eyisiphephelo nohlelo lwakho.

what.en: First test series. Deadlines cluster here, so book a coach in week 4.
what.zu: Uchungechunge lokuqala lwezivivinyo. Izinsuku zokuhambisa ziqoqana lapha, ngakho bhukha umqeqeshi ngesonto lesi-4.

what.en: Any module under 50%? See your advisor that week.
what.zu: Ingabe kukhona isifundo esingaphansi kuka-50%? Bona umeluleki wakho ngalelo sonto.

text.en: Your phone is snatched on the walk back from campus. Your timetable, group chats and banking app were all on it. You have {money}.
text.zu: Ifoni yakho iphucwa usendleleni ubuya ekhampasi. Uhlelo lwakho lwezifundo, amaqembu okuxoxa ne-app yasebhange konke bekukuyo. Uno-{money}.

outcome.en: You're back online in a day, but R800 is gone.
outcome.zu: Ubuyela ku-inthanethi ngosuku olulodwa, kodwa u-R800 uhambile.

tip.en: Surprise costs hit everyone. A small buffer turns them into an inconvenience, not a crisis.
tip.zu: Izindleko ezingalindelekile zithinta wonke umuntu. Imali encane eyisiphephelo iziguqula zibe yinkinga encane, hhayi inhlekelele.

label.en: Use an old phone from family

outcome.en: An old phone arrives by taxi parcel after a week. You missed some group-chat messages about a test.
outcome.zu: Ifoni endala ifika ngephasela letekisi emva kwesonto. Uphuthelwe imilayezo ethile yeqembu mayelana nesivivinyo.

tip.en: Going without a phone for a week costs more than you'd think.
tip.zu: Ukuhlala ngaphandle kwefoni isonto kubiza ngaphezu kwalokho ongakucabanga.

outcome.en: You report it to campus security, use campus computers for a few days, and find a second-hand phone for R300.
outcome.zu: Ukubika kwezokuphepha ekhampasi, usebenzisa amakhompyutha asekhampasi izinsuku ezimbalwa, bese uthola ifoni esetshenzisiwe ngo-R300.

tip.en: Report theft, and lean on campus computers while you sort out a phone.
tip.zu: Bika ukwebiwa, futhi uthembele kumakhompyutha asekhampasi ngenkathi ulungisa udaba lwefoni.

title.en: Surprise: you need a lab coat by Monday

text.en: Your first {mod1} practical is on Monday. A lab coat and safety glasses are compulsory: R350 at the campus shop. You have {money}.
text.zu: Isifundo sakho sokuqala se-{mod1} esenziwayo singoMsombuluko. Ijazi lelabhu nezibuko zokuphepha kuyaphoqelelwa: u-R350 esitolo sasekhampasi. Uno-{money}.

outcome.en: You're kitted out, and R350 lighter.
outcome.zu: Usuhlomile, futhi u-R350 ungasekho.

tip.en: Compulsory kit is a predictable surprise. Ask seniors what your course needs before term.
tip.zu: Izinto eziphoqelelwe ziyisimanga esibikezelwayo. Buza abafundi abadala ukuthi isifundo sakho sidingani ngaphambi kwetemu.

outcome.en: A third-year sells you their old coat for R150 and tells you which practicals are hardest.
outcome.zu: Umfundi wonyaka wesithathu ukuthengisela ijazi lakhe elidala ngo-R150 futhi akutshele ukuthi yiziphi izifundo ezenziwayo ezinzima kakhulu.

tip.en: Seniors sell kit in faculty and res WhatsApp groups and on SRC second-hand groups. Ask your mentor or class rep to add you.
tip.zu: Abafundi abadala bathengisa izinto emaqenjini e-WhatsApp efakhalthi nawe-res nasemaqenjini e-SRC ezinto ezisetshenzisiwe. Cela umeluleki wakho noma ummeleli wekilasi akufake.

outcome.en: You save the money, but practical marks count towards your semester mark.
outcome.zu: Uyayonga imali, kodwa amamaki ezifundo ezenziwayo abalwa emamakini esemesta.

tip.en: Missing practicals is an expensive way to save money.
tip.zu: Ukweqa izifundo ezenziwayo kuyindlela ebizayo yokonga imali.

text.en: Your {mod1} lecturer wants printed course packs and a printed assignment by Friday: about R300 in total. You have {money}.
text.zu: Umfundisi wakho we-{mod1} ufuna amaphakethe ezifundo aphrintiwe nomsebenzi ophrintiwe ngoLwesihlanu: cishe u-R300 sekukonke. Uno-{money}.

outcome.en: Done, and R300 gone.
outcome.zu: Kwenziwe, futhi u-R300 uhambile.

tip.en: Printing and course packs are a real cost. Put them in your budget.
tip.zu: Ukuphrinta namaphakethe ezifundo kuyizindleko zangempela. Kufake ebhajethini yakho.

outcome.en: You split the cost and start studying together.
outcome.zu: Nihlukanisa izindleko futhi niqala ukufunda ndawonye.

tip.en: Ask in your class WhatsApp group who wants to split a course pack. The library help desk can tell you if a copy is on short-loan.
tip.zu: Buza eqenjini le-WhatsApp lekilasi ukuthi ubani ofuna ukwabelana ngephakethe. Ideski losizo lomtapo lingakutshela uma ikhophi itholakala ngokuboleka okwesikhashana.

label.en: Use library copies and student printing

outcome.en: The library has the course pack on short-loan, and student printing is cheap.
outcome.zu: Umtapo unephakethe lesifundo lokuboleka okwesikhashana, futhi ukuphrinta kwabafundi kushibhile.

tip.en: The library is the cheapest place to start.

text.en: Your laptop won't turn on, two days before a deadline. The repair quote is R900. You have {money}.
text.zu: I-laptop yakho ayivuli, ezinsukwini ezimbili ngaphambi komnqamulajuqu. Intengo yokulungisa ingu-R900. Uno-{money}.

outcome.en: It's back in three days. R900 gone.
outcome.zu: Ibuya ezinsukwini ezintathu. U-R900 uhambile.

label.en: Use the computer labs for now

outcome.en: A cheaper repair shop and a week in the labs. You meet the lab regulars.
outcome.zu: Isitolo sokulungisa esishibhile nesonto emagumbini amakhompyutha. Uhlangana nabahlala lapho.

outcome.en: Campus IT runs a basic check and points you to a student-priced repair.
outcome.zu: I-IT yasekhampasi yenza ukuhlola okuyisisekelo futhi ikukhombise ukulungiswa ngentengo yabafundi.

text.en: A fever that won't go away. You don't have medical aid, so a private GP visit costs about R550 in cash. You have {money}.
text.zu: Imfiva engapheli. Awunalo usizo lwezokwelapha, ngakho ukuvakashela udokotela ozimele kubiza cishe u-R550 ngokheshi. Uno-{money}.

outcome.en: Antibiotics and a sick note. R550 gone.
outcome.zu: Ama-antibiotic nencwadi yokugula. U-R550 uhambile.

outcome.en: Campus health sees you the same day for almost nothing.
outcome.zu: Umtholampilo wasekhampasi ukubona ngalolo suku ngemali encane kakhulu.

outcome.en: It takes a week to pass. You miss two lectures.
outcome.zu: Kuthatha isonto ukudlula. Uphuthelwa yizifundo ezimbili.

title.en: Your friend needs their money back

text.en: The friend who lent you R300 says their own money is tight now. You have {money}.
text.zu: Umngane okuboleke u-R300 uthi imali yakhe manje ishoda. Uno-{money}.

outcome.en: Square again. The friendship feels lighter.
outcome.zu: Senilingana futhi. Ubungane buzwakala bulula.

outcome.en: They agree to month-end. You put a reminder in your phone.
outcome.zu: Bayavuma ekupheleni kwenyanga. Ufaka isikhumbuzo efonini yakho.

outcome.en: You take the long way round to avoid them. The debt and the awkwardness both grow.
outcome.zu: Uhamba indlela ende ukuze ubagweme. Isikweletu nokungakhululeki kuyakhula kokubili.

text.en: You've watched one series this month, but about R100 still leaves your account every month for streaming. That's about R1 200 a year.
text.zu: Ubuke uchungechunge olulodwa kule nyanga, kodwa cishe u-R100 usaphuma ku-akhawunti yakho nyanga zonke ngokubuka. Lokho kucishe kube ngu-R1 200 ngonyaka.

label.en: Keep it: it's my one treat

outcome.en: That's a fair choice, as long as it's in your budget on purpose.
outcome.zu: Lokho kuyisinqumo esifanele, uma nje kusebhajethini yakho ngamabomu.

tip.en: Treats belong in a budget too. Just know what they cost over a year.
tip.zu: Izinto zokuzijabulisa nazo zingena ebhajethini. Yazi nje ukuthi zibiza malini ngonyaka.

outcome.en: Two taps and it's gone. That money stays in your account now.
outcome.zu: Ukuthepha kabili bese kuphela. Leyo mali manje ihlala ku-akhawunti yakho.

tip.en: Once a month, check your bank statement for debit orders you forgot about.
tip.zu: Kanye ngenyanga, hlola isitatimende sakho sasebhange ukuthola ama-debit order owakhohlwa.

label.en: Split an account with a friend

outcome.en: Your friend adds you to their plan, and you split the cost.
outcome.zu: Umngane wakho ukufaka ohlelweni lwakhe, futhi nihlukanisa izindleko.

tip.en: Where a service allows it, sharing a plan halves the cost.
tip.zu: Lapho isevisi ikuvumela, ukwabelana ngohlelo kunciphisa izindleko ngesigamu.

text.en: A call from home: your grandmother has died. The funeral is on Saturday, and you have a test on Monday.
text.zu: Ucingo oluvela ekhaya: ugogo wakho ushonile. Umngcwabo ungoMgqibelo, futhi unesivivinyo ngoMsombuluko.

outcome.en: You write the test, but you can't remember reading the questions. Grief doesn't wait for the timetable.
outcome.zu: Ubhala isivivinyo, kodwa awukhumbuli ufunda imibuzo. Usizi alulindi uhlelo lwezifundo.

outcome.en: You are with your family, where you need to be. Back on campus, the missed test has been recorded as zero.
outcome.zu: Unomndeni wakho, lapho udingeka khona. Lapho ubuyela ekhampasi, isivivinyo osiphuthile sibhalwe njengoziro.

outcome.en: Your faculty office arranges a later test date, and you go home for the funeral.
outcome.zu: Ihhovisi lefakhalthi yakho lihlela usuku lwesivivinyo lwakamuva, futhi uya ekhaya emngcwabeni.

tip.en: Email your lecturer or faculty office before you leave. Most universities defer assessments for a bereavement, usually with a funeral notice or death certificate.
tip.zu: Thumela i-imeyili kumfundisi wakho noma ehhovisi lefakhalthi ngaphambi kokuhamba. Amanyuvesi amaningi ahlehlisa ukuhlolwa ngenxa yokushonelwa, ngokuvamile ngesaziso somngcwabo noma isitifiketi sokufa.

desc.en: In matric or taking a gap year, working out where to apply
desc.zu: Use-matric noma uthathe unyaka wokuphumula, usacabanga ukuthi uzofaka kuphi isicelo

desc.en: You have a place and want to know what is coming
desc.zu: Unendawo futhi ufuna ukwazi ukuthi yini ezayo

text.en: A friend asks to borrow R100 until Friday.
text.zu: Umngane ucela ukuboleka u-R100 kuze kube uLwesihlanu.

outcome.en: They pay you back on Monday, not Friday.
outcome.zu: Ukubuyisela ngoMsombuluko, hhayi ngoLwesihlanu.

outcome.en: They understand. It was easier to say than you expected.
outcome.zu: Uyaqonda. Bekulula ukukusho kunalokho obukucabanga.

text.en: Your tutorial starts in ten minutes, and you badly need a nap.
text.zu: Ithuthorial yakho iqala emizuzwini eyishumi, futhi udinga kakhulu ukulala.

outcome.en: The tutor works through a question that turns up in the test.
outcome.zu: Umfundisi uxazulula umbuzo ovela esivivinyweni.

outcome.en: You feel human again. You'll need someone's notes.
outcome.zu: Uzizwa ungumuntu futhi. Uzodinga amanothi omunye.

text.en: Group project call tonight. Your data is nearly finished. You have {money}.
text.zu: Ucingo lweqembu lomsebenzi namhlanje ebusuku. Idatha yakho isizophela. Uno-{money}.

outcome.en: The call drops twice, but your part is done.
outcome.zu: Ucingo lunqamuka kabili, kodwa ingxenye yakho yenziwe.

outcome.en: You take the call from the library steps. Free, and a bit cold.
outcome.zu: Uthatha ucingo ezitebhisini zomtapo. Mahhala, futhi kuyabanda kancane.

text.en: It's a friend's birthday. Everyone is putting in R60 for cake and drinks. You have {money}.
text.zu: Usuku lokuzalwa lomngane. Wonke umuntu ukhipha u-R60 wekhekhe neziphuzo. Uno-{money}.

outcome.en: Good cake. Good friend.
outcome.zu: Ikhekhe elimnandi. Umngane omuhle.

outcome.en: Your vetkoek go first.
outcome.zu: Amagwinya akho aphela kuqala.

text.en: Month-end sale: a jacket you like is R250. You have {money}.
text.zu: Indali yokuphela kwenyanga: ijakhethi oyithandayo ingu-R250. Uno-{money}.

outcome.en: You look great. Groceries will be tight.
outcome.zu: Ubukeka kahle. Ukudla kuzoshoda.

outcome.en: It will be on sale again. It always is.
outcome.zu: Izophinde ibe sendalini. Ihlala injalo.

text.en: Your gran calls in the middle of a study session.
text.zu: Ugogo wakho uyashaya phakathi nesikhathi sokufunda.

outcome.en: Ten minutes of home. You study better afterwards.
outcome.zu: Imizuzu eyishumi yasekhaya. Ufunda kangcono emva kwalokho.

outcome.en: She saves up all her news for you.
outcome.zu: Ukugcinela zonke izindaba zakhe.

def.en: A second chance to write an exam you narrowly failed, usually a few weeks later. Students often call it a supp.
def.zu: Ithuba lesibili lokubhala isivivinyo osehluleke kancane kuso, ngokuvamile emasontweni ambalwa kamuva. Abafundi bavame ukusibiza nge-"supp".

def.en: A code shown with your results, next to or in place of a mark. It says what happens next, such as a supplementary exam. Every university has its own list.
def.zu: Ikhodi evela nemiphumela yakho, eduze kwamamaki noma esikhundleni sawo. Isho ukuthi kulandelani, njengesivivinyo esengeziwe. Inyuvesi ngayinye inohlu lwayo.

def.en: A session where you may look at your marked exam script to see where you lost marks. You usually have to book it soon after results come out.
def.zu: Iseshini lapho ungabuka khona iphepha lakho lesivivinyo elimakiwe ukuze ubone ukuthi ulahlekelwe kuphi amamaki. Ngokuvamile kufanele uyibhukhe masinyane emva kokuphuma kwemiphumela.

def.en: The National Student Financial Aid Scheme: government funding that pays fees and living allowances for students from lower-income households. Applying is free.
def.zu: I-National Student Financial Aid Scheme: uxhaso lukahulumeni olukhokhela imali yokufunda nezibonelelo zokuphila kwabafundi abavela emindenini engenamali eningi. Ukufaka isicelo kumahhala.

def.en: Money for your studies that you do not pay back, from a company, foundation, university or government department. Most come with conditions, such as passing every module.
def.zu: Imali yezifundo zakho ongayibuyiseli, evela enkampanini, enhlanganweni, enyuvesi noma emnyangweni kahulumeni. Eminingi inemibandela, njengokuphasa zonke izifundo.

def.en: Money a funder pays you for living costs such as food, travel and books. It is separate from your fees, and it can arrive late.
def.zu: Imali umxhasi akukhokhela yona yezindleko zokuphila njengokudla, ukuhamba nezincwadi. Ihlukile emalini yokufunda, futhi ingafika sekwephuzile.

def.en: Points that each module is worth. You need a set number of credits to move to the next year and to keep most funding.
def.zu: Amaphuzu isifundo ngasinye esiwabizayo. Udinga inani elithile lamakhredithi ukuze udlulele onyakeni olandelayo futhi ugcine uxhaso oluningi.

def.en: One subject in your course, taught for a semester or a year, with its own tests and exam.
def.zu: Isifundo esisodwa ohlelweni lwakho, esifundiswa isemesta noma unyaka, esinezivivinyo zaso.

def.en: Half of the academic year: about 14 weeks of classes, followed by exams.
def.zu: Ingxenye yonyaka wezifundo: cishe amasonto ayi-14 amakilasi, alandelwa yizivivinyo.

def.en: The rules for moving from one year of study to the next: which modules, and how many credits, you must pass.
def.zu: Imithetho yokusuka onyakeni owodwa wezifundo uye kolandelayo: yiziphi izifundo, namakhredithi amangaki, okufanele uwaphase.

def.en: Being stopped from continuing your course because you passed too few modules. You can usually appeal.
def.zu: Ukuvinjelwa ukuqhubeka nezifundo zakho ngoba uphase izifundo ezimbalwa kakhulu. Ngokuvamile ungafaka isikhalazo.

def.en: A formal request to have a decision looked at again, such as a funding rejection or an exclusion. Appeals have forms and strict deadlines.
def.zu: Isicelo esisemthethweni sokuthi isinqumo sibuyekezwe, njengokwenqatshelwa uxhaso noma ukukhishwa. Izikhalazo zinamafomu nezinsuku zokuvala eziqinile.

def.en: A group of related departments, such as Science or Humanities. Your faculty office handles your modules, results and academic rules.
def.zu: Iqembu leminyango ehlobene, njengeSayensi noma ezoLuntu. Ihhovisi lefakhalthi yakho liphatha izifundo zakho, imiphumela nemithetho yezemfundo.

def.en: The university office for student life outside class: counselling, food support, housing, clubs and more. A good first place to ask.
def.zu: Ihhovisi lenyuvesi lempilo yabafundi ngaphandle kwekilasi: ukwelulekwa, usizo lokudla, izindawo zokuhlala, amaqembu nokunye. Yindawo enhle yokuqala ukubuza.

def.en: The Students' Representative Council: students elected to speak for students. They can help with funding, housing and fee problems.
def.zu: I-Students' Representative Council: abafundi abakhethwe ukukhulumela abafundi. Bangasiza ngezinkinga zoxhaso, zezindawo zokuhlala nezemali yokufunda.

def.en: A website you log in to with your student number, to see your results, fees, timetable and notices.
def.zu: Iwebhusayithi ongena kuyo ngenombolo yakho yomfundi, ukuze ubone imiphumela yakho, imali yokufunda, uhlelo lwezikhathi nezaziso.

def.en: A small weekly class led by a tutor, where you practise problems and ask questions. Often called a tut.
def.zu: Ikilasi elincane lamasonto onke eliholwa ngumfundisi osizayo (tutor), lapho uzilolonga khona futhi ubuze imibuzo. Livame ukubizwa nge-"tut".

def.en: Set times each week when a lecturer is in their office to answer students' questions.
def.zu: Izikhathi ezibekiwe isonto ngalinye lapho umfundisi esehhovisi lakhe ukuze aphendule imibuzo yabafundi.

def.en: Exam papers from earlier years. Working through them is one of the best ways to prepare.
def.zu: Amaphepha ezivivinyo eminyaka edlule. Ukuwasebenza kungenye yezindlela ezinhle kakhulu zokulungiselela.

def.en: Library books in high demand that you may borrow for a few hours or overnight, so that everyone gets a turn.
def.zu: Izincwadi zomtapo ezifunwa kakhulu ongaziboleka amahora ambalwa noma ubusuku obubodwa, ukuze wonke umuntu athole ithuba.

def.en: A note from a doctor or clinic saying you were too ill to write. You need one to ask for a sick (deferred) exam.
def.zu: Incwadi evela kudokotela noma emtholampilo ethi ubugula kakhulu ukuthi ubhale. Uyayidinga ukuze ucele isivivinyo sabagulayo (esihlehlisiwe).

def.en: Signing up for your modules at the start of the year, which makes you officially a student. Unpaid fees can block it.
def.zu: Ukubhalisela izifundo zakho ekuqaleni konyaka, okukwenza ube ngumfundi ngokusemthethweni. Imali yokufunda engakhokhiwe ingakuvimba.

def.en: Checked and approved by the university or by NSFAS. An accredited room meets safety and distance rules, and funders will pay for it.
def.zu: Kuhlolwe futhi kwagunyazwa yinyuvesi noma yi-NSFAS. Ikamelo eligunyaziwe lihlangabezana nemithetho yokuphepha neyebanga, futhi abaxhasi bazolikhokhela.

def.en: The written agreement between you and a landlord: the rent, the deposit, the dates and the rules. Read it before you sign or pay.
def.zu: Isivumelwano esibhaliwe phakathi kwakho nomnikazi wendawo: irenti, idiphozi, izinsuku nemithetho. Sifunde ngaphambi kokusayina noma ukukhokha.

def.en: Money paid upfront to hold a room, usually about a month's rent. You get it back when you leave if nothing is damaged.
def.zu: Imali ekhokhwa kuqala ukuze ubambe ikamelo, ngokuvamile ecishe ilingane nerenti yenyanga. Uyayibuyiselwa uma uhamba uma kungekho okonakele.

def.en: Permission for a company to take money from your bank account every month, for a contract or a subscription.
def.zu: Imvume yokuthi inkampani ithathe imali e-akhawuntini yakho yasebhange njalo ngenyanga, yenkontileka noma yokubhalisela.

def.en: Life Orientation: the school subject that covers careers, study skills and applying for further study. Your LO teacher can help you with applications.
def.zu: I-Life Orientation: isifundo sasesikoleni esifundisa ngemisebenzi, amakhono okufunda nokufaka izicelo zokuqhubeka nezifundo. Uthisha wakho we-LO angakusiza ngezicelo.

def.en: Technical and Vocational Education and Training: public colleges that teach practical, job-focused courses.
def.zu: I-Technical and Vocational Education and Training: amakolishi kahulumeni afundisa izifundo ezenziwa ngezandla nezilungiselela umsebenzi.

def.en: Curriculum vitae: a short summary of your education, skills and experience that you send when you apply for a job or a bursary.
def.zu: I-curriculum vitae: isifinyezo esifushane semfundo yakho, amakhono nolwazi lomsebenzi osithumela uma ufaka isicelo somsebenzi noma somfundaze.

def.en: Your identity document: the green ID book or the smart ID card. You need it, or a certified copy, to register and to apply for funding.
def.zu: Incwadi yakho kamazisi: ibhuku likamazisi eliluhlaza noma ikhadi likamazisi (smart ID). Uyayidinga, noma ikhophi eqinisekisiwe, ukuze ubhalise futhi ufake isicelo soxhaso.

def.en: General practitioner: an ordinary doctor you see first for most health problems. A private GP charges for each visit.
def.zu: I-general practitioner: udokotela ojwayelekile oqala ngaye ezinkingeni eziningi zempilo. I-GP yangasese ikhokhisa ngokuvakasha ngakunye.

def.en: The Property Practitioners Regulatory Authority: the body every estate or rental agent must be registered with. You can check an agent's registration for free.
def.zu: I-Property Practitioners Regulatory Authority: inhlangano okumele wonke umenzeli wezindlu abhaliswe kuyo. Ungahlola ukubhaliswa komenzeli mahhala.

def.en: Information technology: the campus department that looks after computers, Wi-Fi, student email and logins.
def.zu: I-information technology: umnyango wasekhempasini obhekele amakhompyutha, i-Wi-Fi, i-imeyili yabafundi nokungena ngemvume.

def.en: Personal identification number: a secret number that proves it is you. Never share it, not even with someone who says they are from the bank or NSFAS.
def.zu: I-personal identification number: inombolo eyimfihlo efakazela ukuthi nguwe. Ungalokothi uyinike muntu, ngisho nomuntu othi uvela ebhange noma kwa-NSFAS.

def.en: Gigabyte: a measure of mobile data. More gigabytes means more browsing, messaging and video before your data runs out.
def.zu: I-gigabyte: isilinganiso sedatha yeselula. Ama-gigabyte amaningi asho ukuphequlula, imiyalezo nevidiyo okwengeziwe ngaphambi kokuba idatha yakho iphele.

def.en: Lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer and intersex people. The plus sign includes other identities too.
def.zu: Abantu abangongqingili besifazane nabesilisa, abathandana nabobulili bobubili, abashintshe ubulili, ama-queer nama-intersex. Uphawu lokuhlanganisa luhlanganisa nabanye.
